mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and decline in payroll employment signals an economic contraction risk, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a housing starts rate above 550,000 units signals robust consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST > 550,000.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate indicates tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 5.0%, it signals labor market overheating that triggers aggressive monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals demand-pull inflation that prompts central bank intervention, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, a sustained rise in industrial production above 95.0 signals strengthening manufacturing output and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during post-recession recovery when INDPRO > 95.0.
